blocking.where: PRD.md Feature Contracts / FEAT-DOWNLOAD-RATE-LABEL (also TRD.md CON-DOWNLOAD-RATE-LABEL-INTERFACE and TASKS.md TASK-05)
blocking.quote: A refresh with a counter change of 500,000 bytes over 5 seconds writes the label '100.0 kB/s' with class normal.
blocking.why: The same contract says a stored sample "more than twice the refresh interval old" is a restart that writes 0.0 kB/s. The declared interval is 2 s, so the cutoff is 4 s, and a sample 5 s old falls past it. At the default interval the 5 s examples (100.0 and 1250.0 kB/s) therefore produce 0.0 kB/s. TASK-05 only says the test sets "a short interval". A short interval such as 1 or 2 makes the 5 s case fail, and the packet never says the test must pass an interval of at least 3.
blocking.fix: Change both acceptance examples to a gap within 2x the interval, for example 200,000 bytes over 2 s gives 100.0 kB/s and 2,500,000 bytes over 2 s gives 1250.0 kB/s. Alternatively state in TASK-05 that these tests inject interval >= 3 and keep the 5 s gap.

polish.quote: the feature function returns the interval it was given
polish.why: The function name and signature are not defined. This is a hidden-test-style requirement an agent has to invent, and the return type (plain u64 versus Result) is unspecified.
polish.fix: Give the exact signature, e.g. `pub fn measure(store, reader, now_ms: u64, interval_seconds: u64) -> Result<(ModuleOutput, u64), String>`.

polish.quote: Files to modify: src/features/mod.rs; src/module.rs; src/config.rs; src/main.rs
polish.why: The task needs no change to src/config.rs or src/main.rs, since run_action in module.rs does the dispatch. The same applies to TASK-05. Listing them invites needless edits.
polish.fix: List only src/features/mod.rs and src/module.rs for TASK-04 and TASK-05.

polish.quote: sends a desktop notification whose body states the total data received since the module started
polish.why: The notification title is not specified. notify() requires a title, so the agent must invent the wording.
polish.fix: State the title, e.g. "Net Rate", and body such as "Received since start: 3.67 GB".

polish.why: The contract is owned and listed as covered by tests/platform_lifecyclecoordinator_tests.rs, yet that owner builds nothing for it. The real behavior is tested in TASK-04, so the focused test has nothing to assert for it.
polish.fix: Reassign CON-PERMISSION-NOTIFICATIONS to OWN-TOTAL-RECEIVED-NOTIFICATION, or state the one trivial assertion the lifecycle test makes.

polish.why: The bar re-reads the cache only every 15 s while the idea says the rate is read every 2 s. The user sees a reading up to 15 s old. This is not stated as a trade-off anywhere.
polish.fix: Add a note that the displayed rate lags up to 15 s, or set refreshSeconds=2.

polish.quote: an elapsed time of 0 seconds or less changes nothing in the store and writes the label '0.0 kB/s' with class normal
polish.why: A manual `--action refresh` in the same second as a service tick overwrites a real reading in the cache with 0.0 kB/s. The behavior is unclear and probably unintended.
polish.fix: On elapsed <= 0, leave the cache unchanged, or return the last cached label.

polish.why: There is no HTTP client in this standalone app. The line is boilerplate that does not apply, as is the xdg-open and service-web-page paragraph in the runtime contracts.
polish.fix: Drop the HTTP and xdg-open wording for this blueprint.

polish.quote: Set ModuleOutput.tooltip to the label text unless the acceptance criteria state tooltip wording.
polish.why: The `alt` and `percentage` fields of ModuleOutput are never specified for this feature. The agent must choose values, and tests would not pin them.

review.verdict: One blocking defect: the 5-second acceptance examples conflict with the rule that restarts the sample when it is more than twice the 2-second interval old, so the stated 100.0 and 1250.0 kB/s cannot be produced at the default interval. Otherwise the ownership map, task order, kit files, data contract and shared-file edits are consistent, and the agent could build the product once that is fixed. The rest is polish.
